cases.description: CLI doctor knowledge row counts unsettled parsed candidates using the same projection as capture; retained settled sources never appear as new pending work
cases.setup: Actual doctor directory-scoped row and knowledge projection with a synthetic topic, retained JSONL observations and settlement ledger under t.TempDir. No environment HOME change or production state access. Include all-settled accepted/dismissed, mixed pending/settled/malformed/blank, legacy observations without IDs, empty sources and absent files.
cases.action: Read the row and official projection, assert explicit expected pending count and topic state; compare directory inventory and exact source/ledger/topic bytes before and after. Run unchanged N raw-count logic with the explicit directory seam as the red control, then the minimal projection-based repair.
cases.expected: All-settled retained lines report0; mixed parsed unsettled rows report the exact remaining count, matching official capture semantics. Invalid JSON and blanks are ignored, legacy IDs remain read-time-only, and no source, ledger, receipt, lock or marker is created/modified/deleted. Missing sources are empty; real read failures are visibly unavailable rather than an invented pending count. Both English and Chinese notes remain concise. The old count must fail the genuine settled/mixed assertions; existing capture/sensor and translation/receipt contracts remain unchanged.
